AWS indicates this argument will be required starting February 2023. To avoid configurations breaking when that change happens, treat the `oversize_handling` argument as **required** as soon as possible. !> **Warning:** If you use the `aws.wafv2.WebAclRuleGroupAssociation` resource to associate rule groups with this Web ACL, you must add `lifecycle { ignore_changes = [rule] }` to this resource to prevent configuration drift. The association resource modifies the Web ACL's rules outside of this resource's direct management. ## Import Using `pulumi import`, import WAFv2 Web ACLs using `ID/Name/Scope`.
